title: Encrypted persistence, configurable encryptor
body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
This task makes COS use the [latest lagom-pb changes](https://github.com/super-flat/lagom-pb/pull/92) to encrypt the journal. This work prepares COS for proper encryption of events to comply with GDPR/CCPA.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
- once lagom-pb releases, update dependency
- add an env var / configuration for picking the encryptor used, but default to `NoEncryption`

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
n/a

**Additional context**
relates to https://github.com/super-flat/lagom-pb/issues/84
relates to #30
